svg.text: New Ø4 cotter at each slotted nut
Cotters secure nut rotation; they are not the structural load path. Stud threads and cotter bends are simplified boundaries.
Head/slot bearing, nut grade, anchor welds, fatigue and one-catch fault proof remain holds. No lifting capacity assigned.
LT4 R0 · 2026-10-19 | mm · NTS | FITS / WELDS PROVISIONAL
